title: Helix Milestones
description: plan/milestones.yaml: the order the TaskSet is delivered in, as named, demoable outcomes. A priority, not a gate: the loop prefers ready work in the earliest unreached milestone and takes later work when nothing earlier is ready. A task belongs to the milestone that names it most specifically: by id, else by its story, else by its feature.

taskset_revision.description: The TaskSet revision the milestones were planned against.

title.description: The outcome, as people will see it.

demo.description: What the owner can see or do when it is reached.

stories.description: These stories, taken from a feature placed later.

tasks.description: These tasks, usually wiring tasks, taken from a story placed elsewhere.
